mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS train_id, t.train_no, stop_from.stop_order AS from_stop_order, stop_to.stop_order AS to_stop_order FROM train t INNER JOIN train_stop stop_from ON stop_from.train_id = t.id AND stop_from.station_id = #{fromStationId} INNER JOIN train_stop stop_to ON stop_to.train_id = t.id AND stop_to.station_id = #{toStationId} WHERE t.id = #{trainId} AND t.status = 1 AND stop_from.stop_order < stop_to.stop_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_order (order_no, user_id, train_id, train_no, travel_date, from_station_id, to_station_id, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, seat_type, passenger_count, total_amount, status, expire_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{trainId}, #{trainNo}, #{travelDate}, #{fromStationId}, #{toStationId}, #{fromSegmentIndex}, #{toSegmentIndex}, #{seatType}, #{passengerCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{expireTime})

INSERT INTO ticket_order_item (order_id, passenger_id, passenger_name, id_card_no, seat_type, price, coach_no, seat_no, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{passengerId}, #{passengerName}, #{idCardNo}, #{seatType}, #{price}, #{coachNo}, #{seatNo}, #{status})
mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.train_no, o.travel_date, station_from.station_name AS from_station_name, station_to.station_name AS to_station_name, o.seat_type, o.passenger_count, o.total_amount, o.status, o.expire_time, o.refunded_count, o.refunded_amount, o.last_refunded_at, o.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN station station_from ON station_from.id = o.from_station_id LEFT JOIN station station_to ON station_to.id = o.to_station_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, passenger_name, id_card_no, seat_type, price, coach_no, seat_no, status, refunded_at FROM ticket_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, train_id, train_no, travel_date, from_station_id, to_station_id, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, seat_type, passenger_count, total_amount, status, expire_time, paid_at, cancelled_at, refunded_count, refunded_amount, last_refunded_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, train_id, train_no, travel_date, from_station_id, to_station_id, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, seat_type, passenger_count, total_amount, status, expire_time, paid_at, cancelled_at, refunded_count, refunded_amount, last_refunded_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM ticket_order WHERE status = 0 AND expire_time <= NOW() ORDER BY expire_time, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, train_id, train_no, travel_date, from_station_id, to_station_id, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, seat_type, passenger_count, total_amount, status, expire_time, paid_at, cancelled_at, refunded_count, refunded_amount, last_refunded_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (0, 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 2
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order SET refunded_count = #{refundedCount}, refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{refundAmount}, last_refunded_at = #{refundedAt}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN (1, 3)
